scriptLines:
query: 'SELECT DISTINCT
    a.admission_id AS admission_id_bk,

    COALESCE(dp.paciente_key, -1) AS paciente_key,

    COALESCE(dep.departamento_key, -1) AS departamento_key,

    COALESCE(df_ing.fecha_key, -1) AS fecha_ingreso_key,

    COALESCE(df_alt.fecha_key, -1) AS fecha_alta_key,

    a.attending_doctor_id AS medico_id,

    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.department)), ''),
        'General'
    ) AS tipo_admision,

    CASE
        WHEN a.discharge_date IS NOT NULL
             AND a.discharge_date >= a.admission_date
        THEN DATEDIFF(DAY, a.admission_date, a.discharge_date)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS dias_estancia

FROM silver.admissions a

LEFT JOIN gold.dim_paciente dp
    ON a.patient_id = dp.patient_id_bk

LEFT JOIN gold.dim_departamento dep
    ON COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.department)), ''), 'General')
       = dep.nombre_departamento

LEFT JOIN gold.dim_fecha df_ing
    ON a.admission_date = df_ing.fecha_completa

LEFT JOIN gold.dim_fecha df_alt
    ON a.discharge_date = df_alt.fecha_completa

WHERE a.admission_id IS NOT NULL',
